notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.
